name: Danish Government Scholarships
funding: Full or partial tuition fee waivers and/or grants towards covering living costs for highly qualified non-EU/EEA students, administered by individual Danish universities.
deadline: Not specified on the official page; varies by university and institution.
theme: Denmark government scholarship non-EU international students university
source_note: Confirmed via the official Danish Ministry of Higher Education's Study in Denmark portal and the University of Copenhagen's own scholarships page (ku.dk), which describe automatic consideration and tuition+living-cost coverage.

name: Bowdoin College
funding: Need-blind admission for international applicants; meets 100% of calculated need with $0 loans in financial aid packages.
deadline: Early Decision 1 deadline is November 15; Early Decision 2 and Regular Decision applications are due January 5.
theme: US college no application fee meets full need international students
source_note: Confirmed on Bowdoin's official admissions 'International Students' and 'Student Aid' pages.
